glosses: To achieve something positive under difficult conditions.

examples.text: Jews rescued some normalcy from increasingly difficult times by assuaging their constant Angst in the family and community and making do with less.

examples.text: Mecp2^(R255X/+) [mice] developed an overweight body weight phenotype by 10 weeks age and increased liver and heart weight by 8 months age. Abnormal body, liver and heart weight in Mecp2^(R255X/+) was rescued by MECP2ᵀᵍ¹ allele.

examples.text: I rescued a set of antique dining chairs.

glosses: To fix a mistake made while preparing something, especially in cooking.

examples.text: The cook rescued the sauce after it began to curdle.
